_comment: Copy to models.json, replace model with an explicitly chosen installed/provider model ID, and opt into remote calls only when intended. No default model is selected. Remove unused entries. api_key_env names an environment variable; never put a key here. supports_seed is provider-specific and defaults to false. Optional input_price_inr_per_million, output_price_inr_per_million and cached_input_price_inr_per_million fields estimate INR cost from returned usage; null means unknown. context_length is a conservative local planning budget, not a verified provider maximum; confirm server configuration before running. Requests use a conservative byte-based estimate and may be refused before the provider limit.
